summary: Live answer shows a question and the agent's reply as it streams in word by word, with numbered citations that point to a source list. Each turn moves through waiting, thinking, answering and done, and once it is done the person can copy, rate, retry or pick a follow-up question that adds a new turn below.
use: When your agent answers questions from data, documents or the web and people need to check where each claim came from.
When answers arrive token by token and you want the text to build up in place instead of appearing all at once.
When you want to show that the agent thought first, with a short list of what it did, without cluttering the answer.
When a conversation should continue through suggested follow-up questions.
features: Each turn has a `state`: waiting shows nothing, thinking shows a Thinking line, answering streams `text`, and done adds sources and actions.
Write [1] after a word in `text` to cite source 1. A half-typed citation like "[2" is held back until it is complete, and a blank line starts a new paragraph.
Hovering a citation or a source highlights the pair, and a click pins it and opens the source list until the next click.
A toggle like "3 steps · 2s" lists the agent's `thoughts`. Leave out `thoughtFor` and it counts the seconds while the turn is thinking.
Copy, Good answer and Bad answer buttons sit under every finished answer, and `onRetry` adds a Try again button. Copying strips the citation numbers before calling `onCopy`.
`followUps` appear under the last answer once it is done, and `onFollowUp` receives the chosen question so you can add the next turn.
a11y: The steps toggle and the sources button report their open state with `aria-expanded`.
The Good answer and Bad answer buttons use `aria-pressed`, and every icon-only button has an `aria-label`.
Collapsed thought and source lists are marked `inert` and `aria-hidden`, so they drop out of the tab order.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the word fade-ins and other animations are cut to near zero.

faq.q: How do I stream the answer in?
faq.a: Set the turn's `state` to 'answering' and keep updating its `text` as tokens arrive. Each new word fades in, and when the stream ends you set `state` to 'done' and pass `sources`.

faq.q: How do citations link to sources?
faq.a: Put [n] right after a word in `text`, and give a source in `sources` the same `n`. Its tooltip shows the source's `tip`, or its title and detail when `tip` is left out.

faq.q: What happens to ratings and pinned sources when the person clicks Try again?
faq.a: When a turn goes from done back to answering, it starts afresh with closed lists, no pinned source and no rating. Your `onRetry` handler decides how to regenerate the text.

faq.q: Can I show the question bubble somewhere else, like in my own chat?
faq.a: Yes. Leave out `question` on a turn and no bubble is drawn for it, so only the answer appears.
